title: Extend delta-lite audit format to capture SSO assertions and role-inheritance metadata
creator: Ava Chen
schema_fields: type (string): enumerated event type e.g. admin.role.create, admin.role.assign, sso.login, sso.saml.assertion
actor_id (string): hashed actor identifier (sha256 hex) - fast lookup, non-PII by default
actor_confidence (string): local confidence label for actor mapping (high|medium|low)
target_id (string): stable id or external ref (role:role_id, user:user_id)
delta (string): minimal change payload encoded as ordered diff tokens
inheritance_path (string): compact list of ancestor roles for role assignments
saml_ref (string): stable SAML assertion reference (assertion_id) when applicable
saml_audiences (string): comma-separated audience URIs from assertion
trace_id (string): distributed trace id if present
reason (string): human-readable reason or error code
description:
Goal: Extend our lightweight 'delta-lite' audit payload to reliably capture SSO/SAML context and role inheritance metadata while keeping per-event size minimal for high-throughput ingestion. We need a practical tradeoff: preserve forensics for admin actions and login flows without shipping PII by default. This ticket defines the shape, encoding guidance, and ingestion constraints for RBAC-v2 admin events and SSO assertions.

Acceptance criteria:
- Schema fields above are implemented and accepted by ingestion pipeline and Console panels.
- delta field uses ordered diff tokens (op, path, value) encoded as a short string; format documented and supported by decoder lib.
- When sso context present, saml_ref and saml_audiences are populated; raw assertion bodies are never stored unless explicitly opted-in by compliance.
- actor_id is a non-reversible hash by default; mapping service keeps a reversible mapping only in KMS-protected store for authorized auditors.
- inheritance_path captures role ancestry up to 6 hops as a compact pipe-separated list (role:role_id|role:role_id...).
- Events tagged pii_redacted appropriately; ingestion rejects events with unredacted user-identifying fields unless event includes pii_redacted=none and project-level permission exists.

Non-goals: full canonical changeframe redesign, audit storage format changes, or replacing existing long-form audit payloads used by legacy incident investigations.
